CONCLUSION: the preview build is healthy; the reported production blank page at kazob2b.fundlezone.com/marketing is consistent with a stale deployed build (deployment lag) — the user needs to redeploy production. No code fix required here.

action_items: No code changes needed. Close the ticket as 'code is correct — user must redeploy production'. Preview /marketing is fully functional end-to-end.

Caveat for the deployment-lag diagnosis: the preview serves CRA's DEV bundle (/static/js/bundle.js), NOT a production main.<hash>.js. I therefore verified 'Marketing Studio' inside the dev bundle, which proves the source is compiled in, but I could not verify a production `yarn build` artifact (I did not run a build to avoid disturbing the running env). If you want hard proof the prod build includes the chunk, run `yarn build` in /app/frontend and grep build/static/js/main.*.js for 'Marketing Studio'.

Also worth telling the user: /marketing is a client-side SPA route, so the production host must rewrite all unknown paths to index.html. If the deployed host 404s or serves a different index for /marketing, a redeploy alone will not fix it — the SPA fallback must be configured.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js registers <Route path="/marketing" element={<Marketing />} /> outside the ProtectedRoute Shell — correct for a self-authenticated public route.

There is no catch-all <Route path="*"> in App.js, so any unmatched path renders a truly blank page. Adding a 404/redirect route would turn the reported production symptom into an explicit 'Not found' screen and make such deployment-lag issues self-diagnosing. Recommended low-effort hardening.

rca_of_the_issue: Reported symptom: kazob2b.fundlezone.com/marketing renders a blank page. Preview at the same path is fully functional (200, root div, hydrated login card, working marketing API + JWT), and the served JS bundle contains the compiled Marketing page strings. Since nothing in the codebase changed since iteration_31 and /marketing was only added in the current build, the blank production page is attributable to the production host serving an older deployed bundle that has no /marketing route: App.js uses <Routes> with no catch-all, so an unmatched path renders nothing at all — exactly a blank page. Mitigation: redeploy production from the current build, and confirm the production host rewrites unknown paths to index.html (SPA fallback). Optional hardening: add a <Route path="*"> 404 element so a stale build shows an explicit message instead of a blank screen.
